description: This file defines a React functional component for generating tickets in an event ticketing application. It manages attendee input, ticket type selection, blank ticket counts, and generates tickets via API calls. It also allows downloading and emailing generated tickets, with UI animations and user feedback.

methods.name: updateRow
methods.description: Updates attendee information at a specific index in the attendees list.

methods.name: addRow
methods.description: Adds a new attendee row with empty data.

methods.name: removeRow
methods.description: Removes an attendee row at the specified index.

methods.name: onGenerate
methods.description: Handles ticket generation, prepares payload, calls API, manages success/error states.

methods.name: onDownload
methods.description: Downloads the PDF for a specific ticket via API.

methods.name: onSend
methods.description: Sends a ticket via email using API.
